title: Frequency Survival Guide
description: Essential tips and information for Frequency Festival at St. Pölten VAZ.

items.title: Train from Vienna
items.content: Train from Vienna (Wien Hbf) to St. Pölten Hbf takes ~30 min. Regular services run throughout the day.

items.title: Shuttle Buses
items.content: Shuttle buses run from St. Pölten Hbf to the festival grounds. Free with ticket wristband.

items.title: Daypark
items.content: Space Stage + Green Stage: runs ~14:00–22:00. Rock, indie, pop acts.

items.title: Nightpark
items.content: Separate venue area, opens ~22:00 until ~05:00. Electronic, DJ sets.

items.title: The Walk
items.content: The walk between Daypark and Nightpark areas is ~5–10 min.
